extractionComparison.gate: Improve material accuracy with no regression in schema validity, unsafe proposals, or correctly supported proposals; exact same full frozen cases, expected classes and decoding. Summaries are recomputed and checked against per-case scores. Raw proposal rate and class-specific accuracy are reported separately. All material proposals require owner review. A tie retains the base extractor.
extractionComparison.methodology: Matched frozen cases, prompts, schema and decoding compare the original base artifact pipeline with the trained/merged export pipeline. Weight quantization and possibly runtime dtype differ; the result does not isolate LoRA's causal effect. Repository configuration is observed, effective loaded precision is not attested.
